protocol.implementation: chunked ONNX Runtime streaming; four states reset per chunk
protocol.alignment: discard context frames; reset membrane/readout/OLA after warmup
protocol.padding: zero-pad initial context and final incomplete chunk; flush OLA tail
protocol.cropping: concatenate enhanced chunks and crop to stored utterance length
protocol.normalization: enhanced utterance peak; composite scoring modifies input arrays in place
protocol.aggregation: unweighted mean of finite per-utterance values; separate counts
